images.scene: On a sunlit open sea, a small English merchant ship exchanges cannon fire with a larger Turkish pirate galley alongside it; smoke and flashes burst from the guns as the two vessels close.
images.alt: A small sailing ship trades cannon fire with a larger pirate ship at sea.

images.scene: Robinson, now a captive, kneels working in his master's small walled garden at Sallee, tending rows of plants under the hot Moorish sun, a low white house behind him.
images.alt: A young captive man works in a small walled garden beside a white house.

images.scene: From the stern of a small fishing boat under sail, Robinson pitches the Moor over the side into the calm sea; the man splashes into the water beside the hull while a boy holds the helm.
images.alt: A man is thrown overboard from a small sailing boat into calm water.

images.scene: By moonlight, the small boat lies at anchor off a dark African coast while huge wild creatures come down to the sea-shore, wading and wallowing in the surf; two figures crouch low in the boat, watching.
images.alt: A small anchored boat watches large wild animals wading at a moonlit shore.

images.scene: A great lion lies fast asleep on the sandy side of a low hillock at the water's edge, shaded by an overhanging piece of the hill; the little boat floats just offshore in the early morning light.
images.alt: A large lion sleeps on a low hill by the shore near a small boat.

images.scene: Robinson and the boy Xury spread a large lion's hide over the low roof of their boat's cabin to dry in the sun, the coast visible behind them.
images.alt: Two people spread a lion skin to dry on the roof of a small boat's cabin.
